title: Other Ways to Say Yes in English: 20 Better Answers (With Examples)
description:
Other ways to say yes in English: 20 better answers for everyday conversation. You get relaxed answers for friends, polite answers to a request, strong answers when you agree, and answers for plans and invitations. Every answer comes with a picture, a clear meaning and a short example dialogue. After each set of five, you test yourself with a quick quiz and practise speaking by repeating the answers out loud after me.

Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:13 With friends
1:08 Speaking practice: with friends
1:31 To a request
2:27 Speaking practice: to a request
2:49 When you agree
3:48 Speaking practice: when you agree
4:15 Plans and invitations
5:16 Speaking practice: plans and invitations

The 20 answers
With friends: sure, yeah, yep, okay, you bet
To a request: of course, certainly, no problem, by all means, gladly
When you agree: absolutely, definitely, exactly, totally, for sure
Plans and invitations: sounds good, good idea, works for me, count me in, I would love to

Which answer will you use today? Write it in the comments.
